ostrzezenia.tekst: A boiling-water bath is suitable only for acid foods, such as fruits, pickles, jams and fruit butters, and only with the research-based process times of the USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning.
Do not change the proportions of vinegar, vegetables and water and do not use vinegar of unknown acidity; use only recipes with tested proportions.
Use only vinegar labelled 5% acidity; white and cider vinegar can be used interchangeably; do not use wine vinegars, homemade vinegar or lemon juice.

akapity: Cucumbers are a vegetable, and all fresh vegetables except most tomatoes are low-acid foods with a pH above 4.6.
Using a boiling-water bath for low-acid foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
